prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Create a production 8-frame looping RUN animation sprite sheet for Duskguard. Image 1 is exact character identity/style reference. Image 2 is the eight chronological pose guides, read left-to-right top row then bottom row. Output transparent PNG 4 columns x 2 rows, equally spaced square cells, no labels, no floor. All frames same scale and fixed camera three-quarter facing right.
CHARACTER: exactly the slim bone-armored knight in image1, long needle wedge helmet, burgundy torn cape, single straight sword. Preserve identity, armor palette, thick dark outlines and angular coarse pixel shapes. Do not make a paladin or add shield.
CRITICAL HANDEDNESS: sword remains in the FAR hand (the hand on the RIGHT side of the original torso), behind torso. NEAR arm, the visible LEFT-side shoulder/arm in reference, is EMPTY and pumps freely. Guide CYAN = near empty arm and near leg. Guide muted maroon = far sword arm and far leg. Never put sword in cyan near hand. Exactly two arms, two legs, one sword in each frame.
Follow guide limb positions closely: contact/compression/push/flight, then opposite leg, no mirror-copy of whole figure. Constant femur/shin/arm lengths, equal helmet size. Forward torso lean, forceful running rather than walking/dancing. Each row is one half-stride; near leg plants in top row, far leg plants in bottom row. Both feet airborne only fourth/eighth frame. Near arm swings opposite near leg. Sword is carried low diagonally down-right, consistent rigid blade length, small controlled swing in FAR hand. Keep empty near fist clearly visible on left side. Cloth trails left, moderate cape size and delayed wave. Clean eight distinct sequential poses with stable body volume, no bobbing resizing. Flat bone/mauve/burgundy/coal palette, no glow, blur, gradients, motion streaks, extra objects or text. Leave transparent margins. Body center and ground line consistent across equal cells; preserve intentional 9px-equivalent hip vertical trajectory shown in guide.
